articles.title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
articles.description:
“I’m gonna stick with my notion that they do not make the playoffs, that they have this incredible run, and over the last six weeks they have some bumps.”

The post Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Rob Parker predicts the Red Sox will miss the playoffs this season.
Parker cites recent performance issues over the last six weeks as a concern.
Boston fans may face disappointment as playoff hopes dwindle.
